title: Composable Android Build Convention Suite Check

questions.prompt: Which approach best applies composable android build convention suite?
options: Compose small capability plugins and test representative module combinations as a public build platform.
Put release signing in library convention
Apply every quality tool to every lifecycle command
questions.answer: Compose small capability plugins and test representative module combinations as a public build platform.
questions.explanation: The correct approach preserves Gradle’s lazy model, explicit data flow, variant correctness, functional evidence and operability.

questions.prompt: A convention suite should eliminate every module-level configuration difference.
questions.explanation: Coupling coverage, signing, publishing and every analysis tool into the base Android library convention makes harmless modules pay cost and gain unsafe capabilities.

questions.prompt: What is the organising unit of a scalable convention suite?
questions.answer: A cohesive build capability that a module explicitly opts into through a stable plugin ID.
questions.explanation: The answer names the model property that makes the build behaviour predictable rather than relying on incidental script order.
